passage: The city library holds its annual book sale only when at least ten volunteers sign up to help run it. This year, just six volunteers have signed up so far, and the deadline to sign up is tomorrow. Unless more people sign up by then, ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the book sale will not be held this year.
the sale will need fewer volunteers than usual.
the library will hold two smaller book sales.
the six volunteers will run the sale alone.
steps: The rule: the sale happens only with at least ten volunteers.
There are six, with one day left.
Without more volunteers, the condition isn't met, so there is no sale.
Nothing in the text supports changing the rule or splitting the sale.
key: Apply the condition the text states to the facts it gives.
